full_judgment:
25. The informant as the prosecution witness- 1 (PW 1) Bakhtiar Ahmed deposed in the Court that the deceased was his father and on 30-10-1991 when he along with his father were coming back from Ranir Hat Bazar after selling paddy grain by a public transport of jeep carrying more than 22/24 passengers. His father sat in the front of the jeep by the side of the driver. When the said jeep reached to the junction of new road at Sonargaon village the members of Ayub Bahini including the present convict-appellants Ayub, Babul, Rashid, Abul Hashem, Kanchan, Khokan, Ershad, Ilias, Ibrahim, Abul Kashem, Shamsu, Jahangir and another Jahangir blocked the jeep at about 6-30 in the dark of night in the month of October. Ayub pulled his father down from the vehicle and other co-convicts and others inflicted a gun blow on the hand of his father and all other co-convict started to causing injuries by different local instruments and by firing blank gunshot and the co-accused took his father away, thereafter, he could not get any trace of his father even after long search. He went to the local UP Chairman Nurul Azim for help but he declined. On 1-11-1991 he lodged the FIR with the Police Station. During the investigation of the case police could recover the deadbody of his father on 10-11-1991 dug under earth at up the hill at Kalipur village. Previously 'Ayub Bahini' including the present accused-appellants and others at the investigation of one Abul Hashem committed earlier offence of dacoity at his residence and also committed another offence of throwing acid upon his 2 brothers namely Kabir Ahmed and Sabur Ahmed. There were 2 police station cases lodged against Ayub and others who were putting pressure upon the deceased and the informant to withdraw the above 2 cases filed against the accused-appellants Ayub and other co-convicts which motivated to kill his father Abdus Sobhan. 

 61. In this regard, the settled principal of law is that for commission of a criminal offence these are must be presence of actus reus (action) and mens rea (guilty mind). We are satisfied that there are sufficient evidence in this case of actus reus (action) and mens rea (guilty mind) produced by the prosecution for commission of offence under section 302 and 109 of the Penal Code by the present convict-appellants at the standard of beyond all reasonable doubt, therefore, conviction under section 302 of the Penal Code is an appropriate punishment for all the convict-appellants to suffer for life imprisonment. 

 62. Another important aspect of a Criminal Case is that the prosecution must prove a case that there is a chain of causation of event as it took place in the present case. The act of the present convict-appellants from having a meeting for planning to kill the deceased Abdus Sobhan had been stopped jeep thereof and pulling down Sobhan from the jeep which ended with the finding of the deadbody and the confessional statements made by the 2 convict-appellants have proved a chain of causation of commission of an offence of murder and the defence could not break any part of that chain.
